name: dsh-env-probe
description: Zero-dependency DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: probes the local machine environment (OS / shells / runtimes / tools / disks / proxy) once, caches the report, and injects it into every session's system prompt. v1.1.0: diff-only refresh command plus an env_refresh tool for the model, configurable version-probe commands, no /env-suggest.
